data.one_liner: Widget that shows a Rive animation while initializing the app and then navigates to a target screen
data.what_it_does: It displays a Rive animation, runs optional start/loop/end animations, waits for a Future or loading flag, then pushes a new route or calls a callback when finished.
use_when: You need a splash screen with a Rive animation during app startup
You want automatic navigation after initialization
You want to customize transition animations
avoid_when: You prefer a different animation format (Lottie, GIF)
You need a fully custom splash screen without Rive
You are targeting a platform that does not support Rive
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single line of code
Supports multiple animation modes (start, loop, end)
weaknesses: No support for other animation types

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use Rive directly for full control over animation and state management

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Lottie animations instead of Rive
